ana (DevEx): Quick note — onboarding team reports inconsistent error shapes across SDKs; customers confused about whether to retry on 401/403.
leo (SDK): which sampleapps? node + python or go too?
nana (DevEx): mostly node + go. Example from a customer node log: 
```json
{"error":{"name":"AuthError","msg":"request failed"}}
```
leo (SDK): ouch. Missing http_status and code makes automated decisions hard. We should standardize an envelope and expose typed errors.
yasmin (PM): policy refresher: 401 = potentially refreshable -> caller MAY retry after refresh; 403 = permission denied -> no retry. We should also give an actionable hint (e.g., "refresh token" or "request scope X").
dave (eng): proposal for minimal user-facing envelope (server guarantees): 
```json
{"error_type":"string","code":"string","message":"string","http_status":123,"retry_policy":"string","hint":"string","retry_after":"string (optional)"}
```
leo (SDK): SDK implementation notes: Node: class RedwoodError extends Error { status, code, retryPolicy, hint } so apps can do `if (err.retryPolicy === 'none') ...`. Go: type RedwoodError interface { error; StatusCode() int; RetryPolicy() string; Code() string } so callers can switch on type.
yasmin (PM): for `retry_policy` enum use: `none`, `idempotent_only`, `safe`, `always`. That gives clear semantics to app teams.
dave (eng): server-side: add normalization layer in auth-proxy to turn ambiguous 403/500 bodies into normalized responses (and emit `normalized_http_status` in telemetry). Keep stack traces out of the message; full details go to logs/trace.
release-bot: scheduled rollout window: 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC :rocket:
nana (DevEx): compatibility plan: SDKs default to the new typed surface but honor env var `REDWOOD_LEGACY_ERRORS=true` to produce old shape for a short migration window. Sampleapps will switch to new envelope by default.
leo (SDK): test mapping rules planned: 401 -> `retry_policy=always` if auth response `refreshable=true`, else `none`; 403 -> `none`; 429 -> `idempotent_only` + `retry_after` from header; 5xx -> `idempotent_only` default.
yasmin (PM): telemetry: tag events with `error_surface:v4` and `migration_cohort` so we can measure support volume and onboarding drop-off.
dave (eng): for rate limits include both `retry_after` (seconds) and optional `quota_reset` ISO timestamp. Also consider `quota_bucket` if helpful.
nana (DevEx): Action items: @leo implement SDK typed errors + legacy shim, @dave add envelope + auth normalization, @yasmin update onboarding docs/FAQ and add decision table for "When should I retry?" I'll draft the spec with examples.
leo (SDK): PRs starting today; will include sample snippets for node/go/python and unit tests for the mapping logic.
dave (eng): i'll run a small canary in staging once SDK builds land.
yasmin (PM): thanks team — this should cut down support loops and make SDK behavior predictable across languages.
